facts.fact: The Ministry of the Interior lists law 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on the protection of natural persons in personal data processing, supplemented by law 25-11 of 24 July 2025.

The Ministry of the Interior lists decree 23-73 of 14 February 2023 on the missions and organisation of the executive secretariat of the national personal data protection authority; no appointment is stated.
